title: JSON Forms configuration — common profile
description: Form-wide defaults for controls, layouts, validation messages and shared extensions. Individual elements can override applicable defaults in their options.

showTypeIndicator.description: Show object and array type markers in composite cells. Per-cell showTypeIndicator overrides this default, including false.

restrict.description: Enables preventive input constraints, such as limiting text length or preventing array changes beyond schema bounds. Schema validation still applies when false. Temporal controls use jsonformsExtended.restrict for their global default.

hideRequiredAsterisk.description: Hides the visual required marker without changing required validation or accessible required state.

showUnfocusedDescription.description: Shows a control's description while it is not focused.

disableAdd.description: Prevents adding array items. Setting false does not override read-only state or schema-based restrictions.

disableRemove.description: Prevents removing array items. Setting false does not override read-only state or schema-based restrictions.

enableFilterErrorsBeforeTouch.description: Hides control error text until the control loses focus for the first time. This affects presentation only; the form remains invalid.

filterErrorKeywordsBeforeTouch.description: Validation keywords whose messages are hidden before touch when filtering is enabled. An absent or empty effective list hides all control error text before touch.

dateSaveFormat.description: Format used to store date values. Must remain compatible with the data schema's format.

timeSaveFormat.description: Format used to store time values. Must remain compatible with the data schema's format.

dateTimeSaveFormat.description: Format used to store date-time values. Must remain compatible with the data schema's format.

ampm.description: Uses 12-hour time entry with an AM/PM selector.

views.description: Picker panels to offer. Year, month and day set calendar granularity; hours, minutes and seconds select time columns. Each picker uses the views relevant to it. This does not change the stored value format.

jsonformsExtended.description: Shared extension settings for groups, validation indicators, confirmation and layout defaults.

readonly.description: Default read-only state. Rules and element options can override it; the form-wide readonly prop remains an unconditional lock.

readOnly.description: Alias of readonly. When both are specified, readonly takes precedence.

separateReadonlyFromDisabled.description: Keeps read-only fields distinct from disabled fields, allowing interaction without value changes. Requires controls that support separate read-only behavior.

trim.description: Legacy text-input sizing based on the schema's maxLength. Deprecated in this profile; use options.layout sizing.

showSortButtons.description: Offers array-item reordering: Move up/down buttons in tables and expandable arrays, or drag handles in grids.

showArrayTableSortButtons.description: Legacy flag for Move up/down buttons in array tables. Reordering is enabled when this or showSortButtons is true.

showArrayLayoutSortButtons.description: Legacy flag for Move up/down buttons in expandable arrays. Reordering is enabled when this or showSortButtons is true.

collapseNewItems.description: Keeps newly added expandable array items collapsed. When false, adding an item opens it.

hideAvatar.description: Hides the item index marker in array item headers.

hideArraySummaryValidation.description: Hides the summary of validation errors in array children. The array's own errors and individual field errors remain available.

clearable.description: Offers a clear action on supported inputs. Clearing remains subject to read-only state and mutation restrictions.

placeholder.description: Hint text shown in an empty input.

focus.description: Requests focus when a control mounts.

multi.description: Uses a multiline text area for text controls.

autocomplete.description: Enables search within finite-choice controls. Searching filters existing choices and does not create new values.

suggestion.description: Suggested strings offered while editing a text value. Users may still enter a value outside the suggestions.

showNavButtons.description: Shows Previous and Next buttons in a stepper categorization.

validateActiveBranch.description: Validate the displayed anyOf/oneOf branch for local editor feedback. Control options override global config. False skips additional branch compilation and validation; document validation remains unchanged.

dimension.description: A nonnegative pixel count or a nonempty CSS dimension.

extended.description: Defaults for shared form extensions. Corresponding element options can override these settings.

collapsible.description: Allows group and array panels to be expanded and collapsed.

collapsed.description: Collapsed state for Group, mixed object/array frames and accordion categories. Changes update expansion; unrelated updates preserve user state.

showDataIndicator.description: Shows an indicator when a group contains data.

showValidationIndicator.description: Shows an indicator for validation errors in a container's descendants. When omitted, arrays and item headers default to showing it; groups and categories default to hiding it.

showValidationIndicatorCount.description: Opt in to computing and presenting the container error count. Omitted or false uses an error-presence marker without computing a count.

confirmation.description: Confirmation policies for operations that discard data, including deletion and type or branch changes.

layoutDefaults.description: Default spacing, wrapping and grid size for layout containers.

restrict.description: Enables preventive constraints in temporal controls, such as limiting picker selections to allowed ranges. Defaults to true; a control can override it with options.restrict.

tuple.description: Defaults for tuple controls only; local options.vertical overrides.

collapsed.description: Override the shared jsonformsExtended.collapsed default. Omit to inherit; local options.collapsed wins.

array.description: Defaults for array presentations, including pagination and collapse state.

radio.description: Radio group defaults only. Local options.vertical overrides, including false.

dialog.description: Defaults for row and complex-cell detail dialogs. Local dialog properties override these defaults individually.

collapsed.description: Override the shared jsonformsExtended.collapsed default. Omit to inherit; local options.collapsed wins.
Override the shared jsonformsExtended.collapsed default. Omit to inherit; local options.collapsed wins.

structuredLayout.description: Mixed value presentation. Tree is the default; nested uses regular object/array controls; code edits the whole value as JSON with Monaco. Local options override jsonformsExtended.mixed.

collapsed.description: Override the shared jsonformsExtended.collapsed default. Omit to inherit; local options.collapsed wins.

conditionalFields.description: Default opt-in for conditional field presentation in object controls. Local options.conditionalFields overrides.

confirmationPolicy.description: always confirms against any existing value; never skips the prompt; complex confirms only when the discarded value is a non-empty object or array.

confirmation.description: Policies for confirming operations that discard data. Confirmation never overrides read-only state or other mutation restrictions.

default.description: Default confirmation policy for operations that discard data.

typeChange.description: Confirmation policy when changing a value's type.

branchChange.description: Confirmation policy when switching a schema branch would discard data.

renderers.description: Operation-specific policies keyed by renderer catalog ID. These override the default policy.

layoutDefaults.description: Defaults for layout containers. An explicit option on the element still wins.

gap.description: Space between layout children, in pixels or a CSS dimension. Defaults to 16 CSS pixels in both rows and columns. Explicit zero disables the gap.

wrap.description: Allows horizontal layout children to continue onto additional rows.

gridColumns.description: Number of grid columns used to interpret a child's options.layout.span.
